source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting structural defects in a bridge maintenance report

1. Start with the maintenance records.
2.
completion:
Make a list of all defects reported over the life of this bridge; where they were, their location, their description, their severity, whether they were repaired, if so, when and who did it.
3. Make a list of what has been done about any reported problems.
4. Add all the above information to a GIS database.
5. Create a simple means to audit the bridge: give a physical location where a person would stand to observe any defects/problems; note the relative position of the defect with the observers position; write a description of the defect; note the severity of the defect.
6. Maintain a GIS database for each bridge, or set of bridges, that notes the ratings and the specific issues found in the field.
7. Use this information to draw a plan/sketch of the defects in a digital file, pdf, etc. that will be attached to the maintenance report as indicated above.
